name: process_refund
description: Process a customer refund for a given order. Requires the order ID, refund amount in dollars, and a reason for the refund.

order_id.description: The order ID to refund (e.g., ORD-12345)

reason.description: Reason for the refund (e.g., defective item, wrong product, customer dissatisfied)

idempotency_key.description: Stable id for this refund operation, for example operation-123. Reuse the same key when retrying so the backend returns the existing refund instead of creating another one.
